findings.desc: quality-cleanup: lifecycle-registry.ts has two identically-valued constants for the same concept: pre-existing COMMAND_LIFECYCLE_PHASES (line 52) and newly-added LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_PHASES (line 440) — both list the same 7 phases in the same order. No assertion in flow-stability-smoke.ts checks they remain equal, so a future phase addition to one but not the other will silently produce inconsistent contract checks: assertLifecycleRegistryConsistency() (line 859) uses COMMAND_LIFECYCLE_PHASES while assertPhaseFlowDerivedValuesByteIdentical() (line 963) uses LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_PHASES.
